description: Use when the user asks what changed, what's new, or wants a timeline of a competitor's moves. Returns the dated CHANGE-FEED for one competitor: every real was→now strategic shift IndustryLens detected, newest-first, each stamped with its real analysis date (never a fabricated date) — optionally since a given date. Input a domain or name. Returns { covered: false } with a CTA for companies not publicly tracked. Pass `companies` (up to 10 names/domains) instead of domain/name to get a change feed for several competitors in one call — each gets its own result block, in the order given.

companies.description: Batch alternative to domain/name: up to 10 company names or domains. Omit domain/name when using this. Returns one change feed per entry, in input order; `since`/`limit` apply to every entry.

domain.description: Company domain or homepage URL (e.g. 'apollo.io'). Preferred — most precise.

name.description: Company name (e.g. 'Apollo'). Used when no domain is given.

since.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only moves analyzed on/after this date are returned.

name: get_competitor_moves_diff
title: Get a competitor's dated change feed
